jobs.title: Security Supervisor
jobs.description: St. Moritz Security Services, Inc. is seeking a Security Shift Supervisor for the Dallas Regional Office in Richardson, TX. The position runs Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM, with a pay rate of $20.00 per hour. The Security Officer will oversee security services at assigned locations, emphasizing observation, reporting, and post order compliance. The role requires a valid Texas Guard Card, the ability to pass background and drug tests, and at least 3 years of supervisory experience.
